title: Partition of a list by a threshold
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type, let $l$ be a finite list of elements of $\alpha$, and let $x\in\alpha$. The number of entries of $l$ strictly less than $x$, plus the number greater than or equal to $x$, is the length of $l$.
